description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically implementing schema changes, table creations, foreign keys, and initial configurations as part of version 4.4.0. It manages the creation of tables related to a social feed or 'Buzz' feature, including posts, shares, comments, likes, photos, links, and notification metadata.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines migration procedures to modify the database schema for the Buzz social feature in version 4.4.0 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the schema upgrades and initial configuration inserts necessary for the Buzz feature. Creates tables, foreign keys, indexes, and inserts default configuration values, module registration, and menu permissions.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.4' indicating the migration's target version.
